threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'shopping trolley' instead of a 'bag for life' when you’re at the market. The locals notice.
Heard a bloke on the 59 last night trying to barter a half-eaten kebab for a cigarette. The driver just shook his head but it was a proper scene.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a guy selling homemade schnitzel from a bicycle cart at 3 AM outside the Rewe. That's when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a bar that serves beer in old West German soft drink bottles. Yeah, the nostalgia is real, and the vibe is unmatched.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local knows not to panic when the Civic Center BART station is evacuated; it’s just another Tuesday in SF.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the F-line stuck at Civic Center, surrounded by artists painting a mural on the sidewalk while we waited. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think Gràcia is just about Gaudí. They miss the quiet moments at the plaça, where locals debate football while sipping horchata.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stand confused at crosswalks, waiting for the green light while locals just saunter across.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'corner shop' instead of a 'local' and wonder why no one’s helping you find a decent avocado.
Last week on the 37, a guy serenaded the whole bus with 90s boyband hits. You could almost hear the eye rolls, but he was surprisingly on key!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a grandma arguing with a pigeon over a leftover kebab outside the Späti. That’s Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you hop on a tram, get stuck behind a spontaneous b-boy battle in the street, then grab a kebab all within ten minutes.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local when they know to avoid Civic Center Muni after a dog gets loose on the tracks. Tourists are still waiting for the next bus.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 just as a saxophonist jumped on, playing 'Summertime.' For a moment, the cramped bus felt like a concert hall. Classic SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but it's the quiet corners and local bars where the real magic happens, especially after sunset.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still pulling out a map instead of using Google Maps. You can spot them at the terrace trying to figure out the best tapas spot.
